hotel.name: Hotel Wilderwood
hotel.tagline: Where the jungle breathes and silence is a luxury.

location.setting: Nestled at the edge of the Sinharaja UNESCO World Heritage Rainforest, surrounded by 12 acres of private tea and spice gardens.

hotel.overview: Hotel Wilderwood is a 14-villa luxury jungle retreat perched at the edge of Sri Lanka's last remaining lowland tropical rainforest, the Sinharaja. Built using sustainably sourced timber, reclaimed stone, and traditional wattle-and-daub techniques, the property disappears into the canopy — offering an immersive wilderness experience without sacrificing world-class comfort. Each villa is a private sanctuary, positioned to maximise rainforest views and birdsong while ensuring complete seclusion.
awards: Conde Nast Traveller — Top 10 Eco Retreats in Asia 2024

rooms.name: Canopy Garden Villa
rooms.floor: Ground level, raised on timber stilts
rooms.view: Private jungle garden and lily pond
rooms.description: Our entry-level luxury villa — though nothing here is ordinary. Step off your private timber deck directly into your own enclosed jungle garden. Mornings here belong to the purple-faced langurs who swing through the canopy overhead.
features: Private timber deck with sun loungers
Outdoor rain shower with stone surround
Indoor soaking tub with forest view
King bed with organic latex mattress
Hand-woven linen and organic cotton bedding
Minibar stocked with local fruit, herbal teas and artisan chocolates
Nespresso machine + French press with estate coffee
rooms.pricing_note: Pricing on enquiry. Includes daily breakfast and a guided morning jungle walk.

rooms.name: Treetop Pool Villa
rooms.description: Elevated on stilts at canopy height, this villa places you inside the forest rather than beside it. Your private plunge pool seems to float above the treeline. The most popular choice for honeymooners and special occasions.
features: 95 sqm indoor space + 40 sqm wraparound deck
Private infinity plunge pool (4m x 2.5m, heated on request)
Wraparound deck with daybed and hammock
Freestanding copper soaking tub on deck
King bed facing floor-to-ceiling forest windows
Dual vanity bathroom with stone finishes
In-villa bar with curated Sri Lankan spirits
Telescope for night sky and canopy birdwatching
Daily turndown with fresh jungle flowers
rooms.pricing_note: Pricing on enquiry. Includes daily breakfast, one couples spa treatment, and a private sundowner on the deck.

rooms.name: Sinharaja Estate Suite
rooms.bed_type: King master bedroom + separate twin room
rooms.description: The pinnacle of Wilderwood. Two storeys of jungle living — a full master bedroom, a separate sleeping loft, a private stream-fed plunge pool, and your own outdoor dining terrace. Ideal for families or those who simply want it all.
features: Separate twin sleeping loft (ideal for children or companions)
Master king bedroom with walk-in wardrobe
rooms.pricing_note: Pricing on enquiry. Full-board option available. Minimum 3-night stay.

rooms.name: Wilderness Family Villa
rooms.bed_type: King master + two single beds in children's room
rooms.description: Designed specifically for families, this villa has a dedicated children's room with bunk beds and nature-themed interiors, a large shared living area, and a safe enclosed garden. A nature kit — binoculars, field guide, bug-catching jar — is waiting for every young guest.
features: Children's room with bunk beds and nature-themed murals
Large shared living and dining area
Enclosed safe garden (350 sqm) with birdfeeder station
Children's welcome pack (field guide, binoculars, nature journal)
Board games and nature activity kits
King bed in master with ensuite
rooms.pricing_note: Pricing on enquiry. Children under 6 stay free.

dining.overview: Dining at Wilderwood is an extension of the forest itself. Our Executive Chef sources 70% of ingredients from the surrounding Sabaragamuwa region — estate-grown herbs, village-reared poultry, freshwater fish, and hand-picked spices. The menus change with the season and the harvest.

restaurants.name: The Canopy Table
restaurants.setting: Open-sided treehouse pavilion elevated above the garden, seating 32
restaurants.dress_code: Smart casual — no swimwear after 7 PM
restaurants.cuisine: Modern Sri Lankan with international influences
restaurants.description: The heart of Wilderwood's dining. Breakfast here is a ritual — hoppers made to order, fresh tropical fruits, and strong estate coffee as the jungle wakes up around you. By night, the pavilion glows with oil lamps and the sound of the forest takes over.

breakfast: Egg hoppers with three sambols (pol, lunu miris, seeni)
String hoppers with dhal curry and coconut milk
Homemade granola with curd and kithul treacle
Tropical fruit platter (seasonal — rambutan, papaya, woodapple, mangosteen)
Smashed avocado on sourdough with poached egg and chilli
Freshly baked bread and pastries from the wood-fired oven
Estate coffee, herbal teas, fresh king coconut
lunch: Kottu roti with jungle mushroom and tempe (vegan option)
Grilled village chicken with roasted jak fruit and green mango salad
Sri Lankan rice and curry (rotating daily — 6–8 curries)
Pan-seared freshwater tilapia with coconut broth and turmeric rice
Pulled jackfruit tacos with pickled red onion and yoghurt
Wood-fired pizza with local cheese and garden herbs
dinner: Chilled watermelon soup with lime leaf oil and puffed rice
Slow-roasted pork belly with wild boar jus, gotukola puree, and pol sambol
Ambul thiyal (tangy dry fish curry) with red rice and papadums
Butter-poached lobster with coconut bisque and saffron string hoppers
Mushroom and tempe curry with cashew cream and roti
Dark chocolate and cardamom tart with kithul treacle ice cream
dietary_options: Ayurvedic menu available (coordinated with wellness team)

restaurants.name: The Stream Table
restaurants.setting: A table for two (or four) set beside the property's natural stream, under a canopy of ferns
restaurants.description: Wilderwood's most intimate dining experience. A six-course tasting menu served beside the stream by lamplight. Guests are presented with a personalised menu card at the end of their meal as a keepsake.
sample_courses: Amuse-bouche: King coconut jelly with caviar and lime
Cold: Seared tuna with pomelo, gotukola, and black sesame
Warm: Jungle mushroom consommé with hand-rolled rice dumplings
Fish: Butter-poached snapper with coconut foam and turmeric oil
Main: Dry-aged lamb with jak fruit rendang and wild herb salad
Dessert: Kithul treacle panna cotta with tamarind gel and sesame tuile
restaurants.pricing_note: Pricing on enquiry. Advance reservation required — minimum 24 hours. Wine pairing available.

restaurants.name: The Spice Bar
restaurants.setting: Open-air bar on the main lodge terrace, overlooking the forest
restaurants.description: The social hub of Wilderwood. Handcrafted cocktails built around Sri Lankan botanicals — arrack, cinnamon, cardamom, tamarind, and pandan. Bar snacks and sharing plates served all evening.
signature_cocktails: The Serendib Sour — aged arrack, tamarind shrub, jaggery, egg white
Rainforest Collins — coconut gin, fresh lemongrass, lime, soda
Pandan Mule — vodka, pandan syrup, ginger beer, lime
Cinnamon Old Fashioned — bourbon, Ceylon cinnamon bark syrup, bitters
The Wilderwood Cooler — non-alcoholic: king coconut, lime, mint, ginger
bar_snacks: Devilled cashews with curry leaf and chilli
Spiced chickpea fritters with coconut chutney
Beef or mushroom sliders with kithul glaze
Cheese board with local buffalo curd, crackers, and fruit chutney

in_villa_dining.note: Full menu available for in-villa dining. Private candlelit dinner on your villa deck can be arranged with 4 hours notice.
in_villa_dining.private_bbq: Available for Treetop Pool Villas and Estate Suites — chef-attended private BBQ on your deck, by request.

wellness.name: Vana Spa
wellness.description: Vana — meaning 'forest' in Sanskrit — is a spa rooted in ancient Ayurvedic tradition, updated for the modern traveller. All treatments use oils and herbs sourced from the surrounding forest and our on-site herbal garden.

signature_treatments.name: Sinharaja Forest Ritual
signature_treatments.description: A full-body experience beginning with a forest herb steam, followed by a warm oil massage using rainforest botanicals, and ending with a cooling gotukola face mask.

signature_treatments.name: Couples Rainforest Journey
signature_treatments.description: Designed for two — a synchronised massage in the private couples suite, with a shared herbal bath drawn in a hand-carved stone tub overlooking the forest.
signature_treatments.pricing_note: Complimentary for Treetop Pool Villa guests (once per stay)

signature_treatments.name: Ayurvedic Shirodhara
signature_treatments.description: The classic Ayurvedic warm oil flow treatment, deeply calming for the nervous system. Preceded by a consultation with our in-house Ayurvedic practitioner.

signature_treatments.name: Jungle Foot Ritual
signature_treatments.description: A grounding treatment using warm herbal poultices and reflexology — ideal after a day of trekking.

other_services: Daily morning yoga — 6:30 AM at the Forest Yoga Pavilion (complimentary)
Meditation sessions by the stream — 6:00 AM (complimentary)
Private yoga with resident instructor (on request)

pool.villa_pools: All Treetop Pool Villas, Estate Suites, and the Family Villa have private plunge pools.

complimentary.name: Guided Dawn Rainforest Walk
complimentary.description: A 2-hour guided walk into the Sinharaja buffer zone led by our resident naturalist. The best time to spot endemic birds and purple-faced langurs.

complimentary.name: Spice Garden Tour
complimentary.description: A 45-minute walk through our working spice garden — cinnamon, cardamom, pepper, cloves, nutmeg — with tastings and explanations.

complimentary.name: Evening Firefly Walk
complimentary.description: A magical short walk along the stream after dark to witness Sri Lanka's bioluminescent firefly colonies.

complimentary.name: Cooking Class — Sri Lankan Basics
complimentary.description: Learn to make two signature dishes with our chef — typically a curry and a dessert. Held in the open kitchen beside the Canopy Table.

complimentary.name: Morning Yoga
complimentary.description: Open-air yoga at the forest pavilion, guided by our resident instructor.

on_request.name: Sinharaja Deep Forest Trek
on_request.description: A full-day guided trek into the Sinharaja forest interior with a specialist naturalist. Permit arranged by the hotel.
on_request.pricing_note: Pricing on enquiry — includes park permit, packed lunch, naturalist guide

on_request.name: Birdwatching with a Resident Ornithologist
on_request.description: Sri Lanka has 35 endemic bird species — many visible from the property. Our ornithologist leads targeted half-day sessions with spotting scopes.

on_request.name: Village Cycling Tour
on_request.description: A gentle 2-hour cycle through surrounding Sabaragamuwa villages, visiting a rubber tapper, a tea smallholder, and a local school.

on_request.name: White Water Rafting — Kalu Ganga
on_request.description: Transfer to the Kalu Ganga river for a half-day rafting experience on Class 2–3 rapids.

on_request.name: Stargazing Session
on_request.description: Our naturalist sets up a high-powered telescope on the hilltop clearing for a private guided stargazing session — best in the dry season.

on_request.name: Helicopter Transfer
on_request.description: Arrive or depart Wilderwood by helicopter — landing pad on-site. Transfers to Colombo (35 min), Galle (25 min), or Yala (40 min) available.

other_facilities.name: The Nest Library Lounge
other_facilities.description: A cosy indoor lounge with floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, a curated collection of Sri Lanka travel, natural history, and fiction titles, board games, and complimentary teas and coffee throughout the day.

other_facilities.name: Forest Yoga Pavilion
other_facilities.description: An open-air timber pavilion set in the garden, used for yoga, meditation, and private wellness sessions.

other_facilities.name: Children's Nature Club
other_facilities.description: A half-day programme for children 5–12 — guided bug hunting, leaf printing, bird identification, and a nature journal activity. Runs daily at 9:00 AM.

other_facilities.name: Boutique
other_facilities.description: A small curated shop stocking handmade products from local artisans — batik, hand-poured beeswax candles, estate spice packs, local illustrated books, and Wilderwood-branded accessories.

other_facilities.name: Laundry
other_facilities.description: Same-day laundry service available (drop-off by 9 AM, return by 6 PM). Complimentary for Estate Suite guests.

other_facilities.name: Electric Vehicle Fleet
other_facilities.description: The property operates a fleet of electric Tuk-tuks and a 4WD EV for guest transfers within the estate and to the forest trailhead.

sustainability.overview: Wilderwood is built on a commitment to leave the forest better than we found it.
initiatives: Solar-powered — 90% of energy needs met by on-site solar array
Rainwater harvesting and grey water recycling
Zero single-use plastics — all amenities in glass, bamboo, or refillable containers
70% food sourced within 50km of the property
On-site composting — kitchen waste returns to the spice garden
Employs 80% staff from surrounding Kalawana villages
1% of revenue donated to the Sinharaja Forest Conservation Fund
Guests offered a tree planting experience during their stay
certifications: Sri Lanka Tourism Green Leaf Certification — Platinum

policies.late_checkout: Available until 2 PM on request, subject to availability (fee applies)
policies.children: Welcome. Children under 6 stay free in existing bedding. Extra bed available for older children.
policies.smoking: Non-smoking property. Designated smoking area near the main entrance.
policies.payment: All major credit cards accepted. Bank transfer available for advance bookings.
policies.cancellation: Full refund if cancelled 14+ days before arrival. 50% refund 7–13 days. No refund within 7 days.
policies.pricing_note: All room rates are on request — please enquire for current pricing and availability. Rates vary by season and occupancy.

contact.reservations_note: For bookings, our travel consultant Serendib can collect your requirements and forward them to the reservations team, who will respond within 24 hours with availability and pricing.
